inviteText: Invited you as a member club on {{date}}. The association then sees how many active members you have, and you see its shared events in Events.
shareContacts: Share the contacts of our functions
shareContactsHint: Name and club address of everyone holding a function (e.g. president, treasurer). Never private e-mail addresses.
title: Associations
intro: Umbrella associations your club is a member of. You decide here what an association sees.
seesCount: The association sees your number of active members and no other member data.
leaveBody: {{name}} no longer sees your club, and you no longer see its events.
